title: Melon
summary: MEL'ON, noun [Latin melo; Gr. an apple; Latin mollis.] The name of certain plants and their fruit, as the water-melon, the musk-melon.

inlines.v: MEL'ON, noun [Latin melo; Gr. an apple; Latin mollis.] The name of certain plants and their fruit, as the water-melon, the musk-melon.
